select /* CBO10000MMapper.selectComboCodeList */ code ,code_nm from (
select #{code_type} as code_type ,'' as code ,'전체' as code_nm ,to_date('1900-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd') as start_date ,to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd') as end_date ,0 as sort_order from dual union all
select cc.code_type as code_type ,cc.code as code ,cc.code_nm as code_nm ,cc.start_date as start_date ,trunc(nvl(cc.end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd'))) as end_date ,cc.sort_order as sort_order from com_code cc where 1=1 ) cc where 1=1
and cc.code_type = #{code_type}
and trunc(sysdate) between cc.start_date and cc.end_date
and not (trunc(sysdate) between cc.start_date and cc.end_date
order by cc.sort_order
